steps.en: Owner, partner and director details are received from the registry
steps.id: Data owner, partner, dan director diterima dari registry
steps.why_en: Director data is fetched but not saved, and the job is switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Data director diambil tapi tidak disimpan, dan job dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.

steps.en: The received details are stored for use in the decision
steps.id: Data yang diterima disimpan untuk dipakai dalam keputusan
steps.why_en: Shareholders are stored without dates; director data is not stored, and the staff screen shows nothing.
steps.why_id: Shareholder disimpan tanpa tanggal; data director tidak disimpan, dan layar petugas kosong.

steps.en: Details are picked using the date of the offence
steps.why_en: No logic matches the offence date against the registry data.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada logika yang mencocokkan tanggal pelanggaran dengan data registry.

steps.en: Details are picked using the appointment period
steps.why_en: Appointment dates are fetched but never used.
steps.why_id: Tanggal penunjukan diambil tapi tidak pernah dipakai.

steps.en: The system decides to send the 1st reminder to an individual director or partner
steps.id: Sistem memutuskan kirim reminder pertama ke director atau partner individu
steps.why_en: No logic exists to decide this and move the notice back.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada logika untuk memutuskan ini dan memundurkan notice.

steps.en: The system decides to send the 2nd reminder to an individual owner or partner
steps.id: Sistem memutuskan kirim reminder kedua ke owner atau partner individu
steps.why_en: No logic exists to decide this and move the notice back.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada logika untuk memutuskan ini dan memundurkan notice.
